S_STP.answer: Our art club used to welcome new members at one meeting after school. I would add a short video tour that newcomers could watch beforehand. A real conversation could make it easier for the newcomer to ask for help.

W_STP.answer:
From my point of view, the school should offer this session because it could reach pupils who cannot stay after class. Some have to leave as soon as lessons finish, so they rarely get to use school sports facilities. For example, a pupil who takes the first bus home could still join a walking activity at lunchtime. That would give the pupil a chance to join each week.

From my point of view, the school should keep the full break available because some pupils depend on it to rest. A shorter break can leave them with little time to recover before afternoon lessons. For instance, a pupil with several demanding lessons might use that time to eat slowly and sit somewhere quiet. Keeping more control over the break would let pupils decide what helps them prepare for the afternoon.
